output.rationale: The requirement specifies technical conditions for metal-clad switchgear, including ambient temperature ranges, altitude, and seismic/wind loading. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product specifically designed for metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, meeting IEEE standards and capable of being tailored to site-specific conditions. This aligns well with the requirement.
